---
title: "Cards"
listing:
  id: cards-listing
  contents: "cards/*.qmd"
  type: grid
  sort: "title"
  categories: cloud
  fields: [image, title, categories, description]
  image-height: "120px"
mathviz-page:
  category-cloud: true
---

<!-- A grid listing with a category cloud, the way Visual Math Lab's gallery
     has one: the cards must be capped at --vm-card-width with their titles
     flush left, and category-cloud.js must move the cloud above the grid
     with "All" first. The listing sits in .column-page, wide enough for an
     uncapped grid's cards to pass the cap. The cloud is turned on here, by
     mathviz-page:, and the page must still get every option _quarto.yml
     sets (a page-level mathviz: would replace them all). -->

<!-- The cloud's look is the site's: this is the snippet docs/site.qmd
     gives, so the fixture styles it through the documented hooks. -->
<style>
.vm-category-cloud .quarto-listing-category { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.3rem 0.6rem; margin-bottom: 1.25rem; }
.vm-category-cloud .category { cursor: pointer; color: var(--vm-text-soft); }
.vm-category-cloud .category.active { color: var(--vm-accent); font-weight: 500; }
</style>

Some prose above the listing.

::: {#cards-listing .column-page}
:::

<!-- What follows the grid on Visual Math Lab's homepage (its topic tiles,
     the footer), a window and a half of it: when a card's tag filters the
     grid, the page shrinks but still scrolls past the remaining cards, so
     a reader who clicked far down would be left below them. -->
<div style="height: 150vh"></div>
